title: Integrations
personal: Integrations belong to an organization. Switch to one from the menu at the top of the sidebar.
readOnly: Only owners and admins can change integrations.

apps.expired: The connection expired. Reconnect to keep it working.
apps.soonBody: A direct connection to {{name}} is on the way.
apps.viaWebhook: You can already send events to {{name}} with a webhook.
apps.viaAutomation: You can already post new leads to a {{name}} channel with an automation.
apps.disconnectBody: Vertex Connect stops sending data to {{name}}. What was already sent stays there.

ownApp.title: Use your own {{name}} app
ownApp.body: Create an app in {{name}}'s developer settings, add this redirect URL to it, then paste its client ID and secret here.
ownApp.secretKept: Saved. Enter a new one to replace it.
ownApp.saved: App saved. You can connect now.
ownApp.removeBody: Vertex Connect will no longer be able to connect to {{name}} through it.
ownApp.both: Enter both the client ID and the secret.

sync.title: Send leads to {{name}}
sync.mappingHint: Which {{name}} property each lead field fills. Leave one empty to skip it.
sync.chooseAudience: Choose the audience leads join first.
sync.resultSkipped: Sent {{synced}}, skipped {{skipped}} without an email, failed {{failed}}.

descriptions.hubspot: Send new leads to HubSpot as contacts.
descriptions.salesforce: Send new leads to Salesforce as Leads.
descriptions.zoho_crm: Send new leads to Zoho CRM as Leads.
descriptions.pipedrive: Send new leads to Pipedrive as people, under their organization.
descriptions.dynamics: Send new leads to Dynamics 365 Sales as Leads.
descriptions.mailchimp: Add new leads to a Mailchimp audience.
descriptions.brevo: Add new leads to a Brevo contact list.
descriptions.klaviyo: Add new leads as profiles on a Klaviyo list.
descriptions.activecampaign: Add new leads as contacts on an ActiveCampaign list.
descriptions.slack: Send lead and event notifications to a Slack channel.
descriptions.ms_teams: Post new leads and workspace events to a Microsoft Teams channel.
descriptions.whatsapp_business: Notify and message contacts via WhatsApp Business.
descriptions.telegram: Post new leads and workspace events to a Telegram group or channel through your own bot.
descriptions.google_calendar: Turn meeting requests into calendar events.
descriptions.outlook_calendar: Create events in Microsoft Outlook Calendar.
descriptions.google_workspace: Connect Google Workspace directory and contacts.
descriptions.notion: Log leads into a Notion database.
descriptions.trello: Create Trello cards from new leads.
descriptions.clickup: Create ClickUp tasks from workspace events.
descriptions.google_drive: Store exported assets in Google Drive.
descriptions.zapier: Trigger Zaps from Vertex Connect events via webhooks.
descriptions.make: Trigger Make scenarios from workspace events.
descriptions.n8n: Trigger n8n workflows from workspace events.
descriptions.google_analytics: Forward card and profile events to GA4.
descriptions.google_tag_manager: Manage tags for public card pages.
descriptions.meta_pixel: Send card events to the Meta Pixel.
descriptions.linkedin_insight: Track card visits with the LinkedIn Insight Tag.

channel.connect: Send a test message and connect
channel.testSent: A test message was sent. Check the chat.

telegram.step1: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and follow its questions to make a bot for your team.
telegram.step2: Copy the token it gives you (it looks like 123456789:AA…) and paste it here.
telegram.tokenHint: It is kept encrypted, and only used to post your messages.
telegram.addBot: Add {{bot}} to the group (or make it an admin of the channel), send any message there, then look for chats again.
telegram.noChats: The bot has not seen any chat yet. Add it to your group, send a message there, then look for chats again.

teams.step1: In Teams, open the channel, choose ••• then Workflows.
teams.step2: Pick “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received” and follow its steps.
teams.step3: Copy the link it shows at the end and paste it here.
teams.urlHint: It is kept encrypted, and only used to post your messages.

where.brevo: In Brevo, open SMTP & API → API keys, create a key and paste it here.
where.activecampaign: In ActiveCampaign, open Settings → Developer. Copy the API URL and the API key, and paste both here.
where.klaviyo: In Klaviyo, open Settings → API keys and create a private key with full access to Profiles and Lists. Paste it here.

audience.keyHint: It is kept encrypted, and only used to add your leads.
audience.noLists: This account has no lists yet. Make one in the tool, then check again.
audience.autoSync: Add each new lead as it arrives
audience.consent: Leads are added to the list, not subscribed to your campaigns. Email only the people who agreed to hear from you.
audience.skippedWhy: Leads without an email address are skipped: this tool needs one.

dynamics.title: Your Dynamics 365
dynamics.hint: The address you open Dynamics 365 Sales at. Leads are created there.
dynamics.azure: Register an app in Microsoft Entra (Azure), add the redirect address below to it, and give it the Dynamics CRM permission user_impersonation. Then enter its client ID and secret here.

automations.intro: When something happens, check your conditions and act: tell your admins, add a task, or send it to another tool.
automations.deleteBody: It stops running. Its past runs stay in the log.
automations.emptyBody: Start from one of these, then adjust it to fit.

templateBodies.new-lead-notify: An in-app notification for owners and admins whenever a lead comes in.
templateBodies.new-lead-slack: Post each new lead to a Slack channel, or pass it to Zapier, Make or n8n.
templateBodies.hot-lead-task: A task due tomorrow whenever a lead arrives marked hot.
templateBodies.nfc-tap-forward: Send every chip tap to a URL you choose.
templateBodies.meeting-request-notify: Tell your admins as soon as someone asks for a meeting.
templateBodies.new-member-forward: Let another system know when someone joins the workspace.

form.name: Name
form.ifHint: Optional. Without conditions it runs every time.
form.title: Title
form.urlHint: Slack incoming webhooks get a readable message. Any other URL gets the event as JSON.
form.needUrl: Each “Send to a URL” action needs an https address.

webhooks.intro: Send signed events to your own server, or to tools like Zapier, Make and n8n.
webhooks.rotateBody: The current secret stops working right away. Update your server with the new one.
webhooks.emptyBody: Add a URL and choose the events it should receive.

form.urlHint: https only; http://localhost works for testing.

verify.title: Verifying requests
verify.body: Each request carries an X-Vertex-Signature header of the form t=<time>,v1=<signature>. The signature is an HMAC-SHA256, made with your signing secret, of the time, a dot, and the raw body.

keys.intro: Keys let your own software work with this workspace. Each key can only do what you allow it.
keys.rotateBody: The current key stops working right away and a new one is shown once.
keys.revokeBody: Anything using this key loses access right away. This can't be undone.
keys.deleteBody: The key is removed from the list.
keys.emptyBody: Create one for each program that needs access, so you can revoke it alone.

form.name: Name
form.needAccess: Allow at least one kind of access.

use.title: Using a key
use.body: Send it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header:

secretDialog.body: It's shown only this once. Keep it somewhere safe; if it's lost, replace it.
